name: Advanced Micro Devices

eyebrow.en: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. · Common stock · Santa Clara, California
eyebrow.zh: 超微半导体 · 普通股 · 加州圣克拉拉

title.zh: 人人都要的第二供应商。

lede.en: AMD grew revenue 45% to a record $13.4B last quarter as data center sales nearly doubled to 64% of the company. Helios racks with MI450 GPUs are now running at OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Microsoft and Oracle, and AMD guides Q4 revenue to about $17B, with data center up roughly 50% in a single quarter.
lede.zh: AMD 上季营收增长 45% 至创纪录的 134 亿美元，数据中心收入接近翻倍，占公司 64%。搭载 MI450 GPU 的 Helios 机架已在 OpenAI、Meta、Anthropic、微软与甲骨文运行，AMD 指引 Q4 营收约 170 亿美元，其中数据中心单季环比增长约 50%。

s.zh: 2027 年一致预期每股 $16.29 · GAAP 历史每股 $4.60，约 105 倍
2026 第四季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock is about 2.5 times its 52-week low of about $188 but about 26% below its October high.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。股价约为52周低点（约 $188）的 2.5 倍，但较 10 月高点低约 26%。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. Q2 2025 includes an $800M MI308 export-control charge. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。2025 年第二季含 8 亿美元 MI308 出口管制费用。最后一根柱为指引中值。

s.zh: 同比 +45% · 创纪录，高于指引

p.en: OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Microsoft and Oracle now run workloads on the first Helios racks. OpenAI and Meta have up-to-6 GW deals each, and HPE won a $12B Helios order from Vultr.
p.zh: OpenAI、Meta、Anthropic、微软与甲骨文已在首批 Helios 机架上运行负载。OpenAI 与 Meta 各有最多 6 吉瓦协议，HPE 获得 Vultr 价值 120 亿美元的 Helios 订单。

p.en: Cloud and enterprise server sales each more than doubled, and data center operating margin rose to 34% from 25%.
p.zh: 云与企业服务器销售均翻倍以上，数据中心营业利润率由 25% 升至 34%。

p.en: Q4 gross margin is guided to about 55%, below 56% in Q3 and the 55.3% analysts expected, as lower-margin MI450 racks ramp.
p.zh: Q4 毛利率指引约 55%，低于 Q3 的 56% 及分析师预期的 55.3%，因毛利较低的 MI450 机架放量。

p.en: Gaming fell 40% in Q3 and AMD expects client and gaming revenue to drop more than 20% in Q4.
p.zh: Q3 游戏业务下降 40%，AMD 预计 Q4 客户端与游戏收入下降逾 20%。

p.en: OpenAI and Meta hold warrants for 160M shares each; their fair value cost $1.1B in Q3 GAAP earnings and should rise. Inventory reached $11.5B and free cash flow fell to $554M.
p.zh: OpenAI 与 Meta 各持 1.6 亿股认股权证，其公允价值变动令 Q3 GAAP 利润减少 11 亿美元，且预计将增加。库存升至 115 亿美元，自由现金流降至 5.54 亿美元。

p.en: Data center revenue guided up about 50% from Q3 as Helios and 'Venice' EPYC production scale.
p.zh: 随着 Helios 与 'Venice' EPYC 量产，数据中心收入指引较 Q3 增长约 50%。

p.en: Guide: about $17.0B ±3% revenue, ~55% non-GAAP gross margin, ~$3.75B operating expenses.
p.zh: 指引：营收约 170 亿 ±3%，非GAAP毛利率约 55%，营业费用约 37.5 亿美元。

p.en: First gigawatt of MI450 for Anthropic begins.
p.zh: Anthropic 首个吉瓦 MI450 开始部署。

sources: Price, market cap and consensus EPS: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Nov 3, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Nov 3, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年11月3日（2026 第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 2021 to Q3 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第四季至 2026 年第三季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: AMD generates cash every quarter, but it was modest ($0.2–1.1B a quarter) through 2023 and 2024. AI GPUs and server CPUs lifted it to $1.6–2.6B a quarter, until Q3 2026 fell to $554M: operating cash flow halved to $1.2B as inventory built to $11.5B for the Helios ramp, and capex stayed high at $648M.
read.zh: AMD 每季都有正自由现金流，但 2023–2024 年规模不大（每季 2–11 亿美元）。AI GPU 与服务器 CPU 将其推升至每季 16–26 亿美元，直到 2026 年 Q3 降至 5.54 亿：为 Helios 放量库存增至 115 亿美元，经营现金流减半至 12 亿，资本开支仍高达 6.48 亿。

read.en: With Q4 guided to $17B and that inventory turning into Helios shipments, I expect $2.3–3.3B a quarter, about $10.6B over the next four quarters. Rack-scale inventory, customer warrants and supply commitments could keep individual quarters lumpy.
read.zh: Q4 指引 170 亿美元，库存将转化为 Helios 出货，我预计每季 23–33 亿美元，未来四季合计约 106 亿。机架级库存、客户认股权证与供应承诺可能使单季继续波动。

p.en: Inventory reached $11.5B at the end of Q3 ahead of the Q4 Helios ramp.
p.zh: Q3 末库存达 115 亿美元，为 Q4 Helios 放量备货。

p.en: Unconditional purchase commitments were $30.3B in June, most due within a year.
p.zh: 6 月时无条件采购承诺为 303 亿美元，大部分一年内到期。

p.en: Up to $5B, tied to deployment milestones.
p.zh: 最多 50 亿美元，与部署里程碑挂钩。

p.en: None in Q3, after $0.2–0.5B a quarter earlier in the year.
p.zh: Q3 未回购，此前每季 2–5 亿美元。

p.en: Data center revenue is guided up about 50% in Q4 and is expected to more than double in 2027.
p.zh: Q4 数据中心收入指引环比增约 50%，预计 2027 年翻倍以上。

p.en: $4.75B of notes sold in August are in the Sep cash balance; total debt is $7.1B.
p.zh: 8 月发行的 47.5 亿美元票据已计入 9 月现金余额；总债务 71 亿美元。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes the up-to-$5B Anthropic investment, any cash settlement tied to customer warrants and any debt repayment.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入最多 50 亿美元的 Anthropic 投资、与客户认股权证相关的现金结算及偿债。

extraNote.en: Q2 2025 operating cash flow and capex are from AMD's release ($1.5B continuing operations, $1.18B free cash flow).
extraNote.zh: 2025 年第二季经营现金流与资本开支取自 AMD 新闻稿（持续经营 15 亿美元，自由现金流 11.8 亿）。
